dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
From Report on the Property of the New York & Richmond Coal Company (New York, Pruden &. Martin's Steam Print, 1856)
Outline map of southeastern Virginia showing railroad connections in Richmond, Petersburg, and West Point. Indicates the Lynchburgh canal.
dct_title_s: Map of the Springfield & Deep Run estates on the Coal Lands of the N. York & Richmond Coal Co, in Henrico Co. Virginia, their relative position to the city of Richmond with rail road connections &c
